name: lem-hcb3-diagonal-upper-norm
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb3-diagonal-upper-norm — Uniform diagonal Ha upper norm: there are universal C_up < infinity and e_up > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_up, every n >= 1, and every Z in M_n tensor S_P satisfy ||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(Z)|| <= (1+C_up*e)||Z||.
